name: Chloe Coleman
bio: Chloe Coleman (born December 11, 2008) is an American actress. She made her acting debut at the age of 5 in an episode of the Fox television series Glee in 2013. She has African-American descent through her father, and Czech and English descent through her mother.

credits.title: F.A.S.T.
credits.overview: A former special forces commando, down on his luck after returning Stateside, is recruited by the DEA to lead a covert black ops team to take down CIA-protected drug dealers.

credits.title: Mouse
credits.overview: In 2002 Arkansas, Callie and Minnie’s friendship is suddenly upended the summer before their senior year of high school. Left rudderless without her best friend, Minnie forms a complicated bond with Callie’s mother.

credits.title: Relatively Normal
credits.overview: The film follows teenager Hannah Glass as she rides out pandemic lockdown under one roof with her family and learns that the real threat isn’t only what’s happening outside the house.

credits.title: My Spy The Eternal City
credits.overview: JJ, a veteran CIA agent, reunites with his protégé Sophie, in order to prevent a catastrophic nuclear plot targeting the Vatican.

credits.title: Pain Hustlers
credits.overview: After losing her job, a single mom falls into a lucrative but ultimately dangerous scheme selling prescription drugs.

credits.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
credits.overview: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic, but things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people.

65 million years ago, the only 2 survivors of a spaceship from Somaris that crash-landed on Earth, must fend off dinosaurs to reach the escape vessel in time before an imminent asteroid strike threatens to destroy the planet.

credits.title: Avatar: The Way of Water
credits.overview: Set more than a decade after the events of the first film, learn the story of the Sully family (Jake, Neytiri, and their kids), the trouble that follows them, the lengths they go to keep each other safe, the battles they fight to stay alive, and the tragedies they endure.

credits.title: Marry Me
credits.overview: After finding out about her fiancé's cheating ways, a pop superstar impulsively marries a total stranger. They must soon decide if two people from such different worlds can find true love.

credits.title: Gunpowder Milkshake
credits.overview: To protect an 8-year-old girl, a dangerous assassin reunites with her mother and her lethal associates to take down a ruthless crime syndicate and its army of henchmen.

credits.title: Timmy Failure: Mistakes Were Made
credits.overview: An 11-year old boy believes that he is the best detective in town and runs the agency Total Failures with his best friend, an imaginary 1,200 pound polar bear.

credits.title: My Spy
credits.overview: A hardened CIA operative finds himself at the mercy of a precocious 9-year-old girl, having been sent undercover to surveil her family.

credits.title: Puppy Star Christmas
credits.overview: The Pup Star family just got bigger! And the new pups: Cindy, Rosie, Charlie, and Brody will have to learn the true meaning of Christmas.
